baseline.failure: CC 5 on MIDI channel 2 switched to Note Masks and never returned to Device Config
CC 5 on MIDI channel 2 switched to Note Masks and never returned to Device Config

rationale: handle_midi_event_data compared the whole CC status byte with 176, so only CCs on MIDI channel 1 started the two-second page-return timer; a mapped CC on channels 2-16 switched the channel editor to the mask page (through the norns pmap action) and never returned. The check now masks the channel nibble: (data[1] & 0xf0) == 176.
oracle: README 197-211 documents selected-channel MIDI maps but not the page switch or return; the return on MIDI channels 1-16 is the recorded human decision of 2026-09-11 for S10 (docs/testing/suspected-defects.md). The case labels its assertions characterisation, not manual text.
